pairs.thin_request: Write an email to the client about the project delay.
pairs.thin_answer: Hi [Client Name], I'm writing to let you know that [Project Name] will be delayed. We had planned to deliver on [original date], and we now expect to deliver by [new date]. The delay is due to [brief, honest reason, e.g., an unexpected technical issue / a late dependency / a change in scope]. I know this is not the news you were hoping for, and I apologize for the inconvenience it causes on your end.
pairs.thin_full:
Subject: Update on Your Project Timeline

Hi [Client Name],

I'm writing to let you know that [Project Name] will be delayed. We had planned to deliver on [original date], and we now expect to deliver by [new date].

The delay is due to [brief, honest reason, e.g., an unexpected technical issue / a late dependency / a change in scope]. I know this is not the news you were hoping for, and I apologize for the inconvenience it causes on your end.

Here is what we are doing to get things back on track:

  • [Action 1, e.g., reallocating resources to the affected work]
  • [Action 2, e.g., prioritizing the items that matter most to you]
  • [Action 3, e.g., adding a mid-point check-in to confirm progress]

Here is the updated schedule:

  • [Milestone 1]: [date]
  • [Milestone 2]: [date]
  • Final delivery: [new date]

If the new date creates a problem for you, please tell me. I'm happy to talk through options, such as delivering part of the work earlier or adjusting the scope.

I'll send you a progress update on [date] so you always know where things stand. Thank you for your patience and your trust. I'm committed to delivering something you'll be happy with.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title / Company]
[Phone / Email]
pairs.directed_request: Act as a senior account manager at a consulting firm. Write an email to a long-term client explaining that a deliverable they expected Friday will now arrive Tuesday. The delay is due to a data quality issue we caught during QA, something that will improve the final output. The client is detail-oriented and tends to interpret silence as incompetence. The tone should be direct and professional, not apologetic. Open with the updated timeline, explain the reason briefly, and close with what they can expect next. Under 150 words.
pairs.directed_answer:
Subject: Updated delivery: [Deliverable] now arriving Tuesday

Hi [Name],

The [deliverable] will reach you Tuesday, [date], rather than this Friday.

During final QA, we found a data quality issue in [source/dataset]. Delivering on schedule would have meant shipping output we couldn't fully stand behind. We're correcting the affected records and re-validating the results, which will make the final analysis more reliable.

Here's what to expect:

  • Monday: Corrections and validation complete. I'll send you a brief status note.
  • Tuesday, by [time]: Full deliverable in your inbox, along with a short summary of the issue and how we resolved it.

If it would help to review the data findings before Tuesday, I'm glad to set up a call.

Best regards, [Your name]

data.after: What changed: the second request says who is writing, who is reading, why it's late and how that reader takes bad news. The first answer is a template that apologizes. The second leads with the new date, gives the reason in two sentences, and needs only the names and dates filled in. The book calls this the Role, Task, Constraint brief, and it is the habit the whole method is built on.

pairs.title: An email to a supplier about late deliveries
pairs.thin_request: Write an email to a supplier about late deliveries.
pairs.thin_answer: Hi [Supplier Contact Name], I'm writing about the late deliveries we've had on our recent orders. Over the past [timeframe], several shipments have arrived after the agreed dates...
pairs.thin_full:
Subject: Late Deliveries on Recent Orders

Hi [Supplier Contact Name],

I'm writing about the late deliveries we've had on our recent orders. Over the past [timeframe], several shipments have arrived after the agreed dates, including:

  • Order #[number], due [date], received [date]
  • Order #[number], due [date], received [date]
  • Order #[number], due [date], received [date]

These delays have caused problems on our side, including [missed customer commitments / production holdups / extra costs]. We value our relationship with [Supplier Company] and want to find a way to fix this.

Could you please:

  1. Explain what caused the delays.
  2. Confirm the delivery dates for any open orders.
  3. Share the steps you will take to keep future shipments on schedule.

If on-time delivery does not improve, we may need to review our arrangement. I would much rather resolve this together.

Thank you for your attention to this. I look forward to your reply.

pairs.directed_request: Act as an operations manager at a mid-sized distribution company. Write an email to our supplier's account rep. Three of their last five shipments arrived two to four days late, and last week's delay made us miss a customer's restock date. We want to keep working with them. Ask for a call this week and a written plan to get deliveries back on schedule by the end of the month. Firm and specific, not angry. Under 150 words.
pairs.directed_answer: We value our partnership, and I want to raise a problem before it grows. Three of your last five shipments arrived two to four days late. Last week's delay caused us to miss a customer's restock date, which has a real cost for us and for them.
pairs.directed_full:
Subject: Late deliveries and a plan to fix them

Hi [Name],

We value our partnership, and I want to raise a problem before it grows. Three of your last five shipments arrived two to four days late. Last week's delay caused us to miss a customer's restock date, which has a real cost for us and for them.

I'd like to get this resolved and keep working together. Could we schedule a call this week to go over what's driving the delays?

After the call, please send a written plan by [date] that covers:

  • The root cause of the recent delays
  • The specific steps you'll take to fix them
  • A schedule showing on-time delivery restored by the end of the month

If there are constraints on our side that contribute, tell me and we'll address them.

I'm available [days/times]. Thanks for your help with this.

Best regards, [Your Name], Operations Manager, [Company]

pairs.title: A letter to a tax client about a late filing
pairs.thin_request: Write a letter to a client explaining why their tax return will be filed late.
pairs.thin_answer: Dear [Client Name], I am writing to let you know that your [Tax Year] tax return will not be filed by the [filing deadline, e.g., April 30] deadline...
pairs.thin_full:
[Your Name]
[Your Firm or Practice Name]
[Address]
[Phone] | [Email]

[Date]

[Client Name]
[Client Address]

Re: Your [Tax Year] Tax Return

Dear [Client Name],

I am writing to let you know that your [Tax Year] tax return will not be filed by the [filing deadline, e.g., April 30] deadline. I want to explain why, what it means for you, and what we are doing to resolve it.

Why the return is delayed

We are still waiting on [a T-slip / K-1 / corrected statement / signed document] from [source, e.g., your brokerage, employer, or partnership]. Without it, we cannot report your income accurately. Filing with estimated figures would risk errors that could trigger a reassessment, penalties, or a request for amended returns later. Filing it correctly the first time is the safer choice.

[Alternative or additional reasons, as applicable:]

  • Some of the documents we received were incomplete, and we have asked you for the missing items.
  • Your return involves [rental income, business income, foreign assets, or a sale of property] that needs extra review.
  • A change in [tax rules or filing software] on [date] pushed back our work schedule.

What this means for you

  • If you owe tax: Interest and late-filing penalties generally start to accrue from the original deadline. To limit this, I recommend sending an estimated payment of $[amount] by [date]. Any overpayment will be refunded when the return is assessed.
  • If you are due a refund: There is usually no penalty for filing late. Your refund will simply arrive later than it otherwise would.
  • If you are expecting benefits or credits tied to your return, they may be delayed until the return is processed.

What happens next

  1. We will file the return as soon as we receive [missing item]. We expect to do so by [target date].
  2. Please send [missing item or action required] by [date].
  3. I will confirm with you as soon as the return has been filed and send you a copy for your records.

I apologize for the inconvenience and understand that this is not the news you were hoping for. If you have questions or would like to talk through any of this, please call me at [phone] or reply to this letter. I am happy to help.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Title]
[Firm or Practice Name]
pairs.directed_request: Act as the owner of a small bookkeeping and tax practice writing to a long-time client. Write a short letter explaining that their personal tax return will be filed two days later than we planned, because one investment slip from their bank arrived late and we won't file without it. Filing with every slip avoids a correction later. The client is a retired teacher who worries about penalties. Tell them we will not charge any extra fee for the delay and that we'll call them the day it's filed. Warm, plain language, no jargon. Under 150 words.
pairs.directed_answer: I'm writing with a small update on your tax return. One of your investment slips from your bank arrived late, and we won't file without it. Filing with every slip in hand means we avoid having to correct the return afterward, which is the safer path for you. Because of this, your return will be filed two days later than we planned. Please don't worry about penalties. This short delay is well within the time you have, and nothing about it puts you at risk.
pairs.directed_full:
Dear [Name],

I'm writing with a small update on your tax return. One of your investment slips from your bank arrived late, and we won't file without it. Filing with every slip in hand means we avoid having to correct the return afterward, which is the safer path for you.

Because of this, your return will be filed two days later than we planned. Please don't worry about penalties. This short delay is well within the time you have, and nothing about it puts you at risk.

We will not charge any extra fee for the delay. We'll also call you the day your return is filed, so you'll hear it from us right away.

If you have any questions in the meantime, just pick up the phone. I'm always glad to hear from you.

Warmly, [Your name], [Practice name]
pairs.note: Read it before you send it. The better letter tells the client not to worry about penalties, and nobody gave the AI that fact. That is why the book teaches a two-step check before your name goes on anything.

pairs.title: A grant paragraph for a community association
pairs.thin_request: Write a grant application paragraph for our community association.
pairs.thin_answer: Our community association has served as a hub for neighbourhood connection, safety, and shared growth for over a decade...
pairs.thin_full:
Our community association has served as a hub for neighbourhood connection, safety, and shared growth for over a decade. We are requesting funding to expand our programming through a revitalized community space, offering free workshops, youth mentorship, seniors' social programs, and seasonal events open to all residents. These funds will directly support facility upgrades, program supplies, and volunteer training, allowing us to reach more households, particularly those facing barriers such as limited income, language, or mobility. With a volunteer-driven model and strong local partnerships, every dollar goes further: we anticipate engaging at least 500 residents over the next year, strengthening social ties, reducing isolation, and building a more resilient, inclusive community. Your investment will leave a lasting, measurable impact on the people who call this neighbourhood home.

Tip: Swap in your association's name, location, founding year, and specific numbers or program details to match the funder's priorities.
pairs.directed_request: Act as the volunteer treasurer of a small community association applying for a $5,000 city grant to replace the park benches. Write the one-paragraph project summary. The reviewers score on community need and on how the money will be spent. We have 140 member households, the benches are 22 years old, and two were removed for safety last summer. Write in warm, plain first person plural, the way a retired school principal would speak at a board meeting. No buzzwords. Under 120 words.
pairs.directed_answer: We have 140 member households, and every one of them knows our park benches. They are 22 years old, and last summer we had to remove two for safety because the wood and bolts could no longer be trusted.
pairs.directed_full: We have 140 member households, and every one of them knows our park benches. They are 22 years old, and last summer we had to remove two for safety because the wood and bolts could no longer be trusted. Neighbors now stand or sit on the grass, and older residents and parents with small children feel it most. We are asking for $5,000 to replace the worn benches. Every dollar goes to the benches themselves: materials, delivery, and installation. Our volunteers will handle the removal of the old ones and the site cleanup, so nothing goes to overhead. These benches will serve us for decades.
pairs.note: The one-line version invented details nobody gave it, such as "over a decade". The explained version used the real numbers.

paras: I'm Elvin Peters, and I'm not a tech wizard. If you've ever typed one line and got a brochure back, me too. My answers were poor until I learned to treat AI like a person who can't read my mind and will do the job however it sees fit until I say exactly how. I still slip when I'm lazy, and I pay for it by doing the work again, so I measure twice and cut once.

AI turned research that used to take me days into hours. I ran paid media for easyfinancial, more than $50M in digital ad spend, then advised advertisers on Google's global clients team. In 2026 I became a founder, writing books and building with AI full time.

items.q: Is it safe to paste client or work information into AI?
items.a: The book's rule: never paste anything into a public AI chat that you wouldn't post on a public social media feed. Chapter 2 lists what to keep out: personal identifiers, confidential business information such as client lists and anything under NDA, and privileged advice from doctors, lawyers or accountants.

items.q: I'm not technical. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes, it's meant for beginners. It was written for professionals who tried AI and shrugged, and for people whose company just told them to use it.

items.q: I tried ChatGPT and it was useless. Why would this be different with the same free tool?
items.a: Because the request changes, and the tool stays the same. A one-line request gets a generic answer from any AI. The book teaches you to explain the job: who it's for, why it matters, and what done looks like. Both answers at the top of this page came from the same AI.

items.q: Do I need a paid AI plan?
items.a: No. The book's skills work across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot, and a free plan is enough to start.

items.q: Will it work for my kind of work?

data.job_html:
One job from the guide, in full.

The internet bill, start here if money is the goal

The problem: The bill went up after a discount ended. In this example the internet is $95 a month, you have been a customer for 6 years, the promo ended 2 months ago, you are not in a contract, and you saw a competitor ad for $60 at the same speed. Those amounts are made up. Change the numbers in the brackets to your own bill before you send.

Paste this

Help me call about this bill. Act as a customer retention agent at a phone or internet company.

My internet bill is [$95] a month. I have been a customer for [6 years]. A promo ended [2 months] ago. I am not in a contract. I saw a competitor ad for [$60] a month at the same speed.

Ask me one question if something is missing. Then give me the call plan: who to ask for, the first sentence I say, what I ask for, and the lowest monthly price I will accept. Then play the company for one round so I can practise.

A good answer looks like this: It asks one short question if a contract or a bundle is unclear. Then it names who to ask for, gives you the first sentence, sets the lowest price you will accept, and tells you to get the new price in writing before you hang up. It warns you not to take a new fixed term until you know the price after that term ends.

Your next click: Call the company. Ask for retention, or for loyalty. Read the first sentence from the answer. Write down the new monthly price and the confirmation number before you hang up. If they push a new contract, ask what the price becomes when it ends, and decide after you hear that number.

You did it when the confirmation number is on a piece of paper or in an email from them, and you know the price on the next bill. The company can still say no, and you have still made the call.
